<thought>Based on the molecular formula C5H8O2 and DBE = 2, a plausible structure is methyl acrylate (SMILES = C=CC(=O)OC). The connected fragments that can be joined to form this molecule are the acrylic acid fragment “C=CC(=O)O” and a methyl group “C”. Therefore the required list of SMILES strings for the fragments is ['C=CC(=O)O', 'C'].</thought>
<final_answer>['C=CC(=O)O', 'C']</final_answer>
